title: Donnie Darko
events_chronological: Years earlier the old woman Roberta Sparrow tells Donnie that every living creature on this earth dies alone.
On 2 October 1988 Donnie is woken by a voice and sleepwalks out of the house onto a golf course.
A jet engine falls out of nowhere and destroys Donnie's bedroom while he is outside.
In the restored timeline Donnie stays in his bed laughing, and is killed when the engine comes through the roof.
Donnie wakes on the green with "28:06:42:12" written on his arm by a figure in a rabbit suit who calls himself Frank.
The family is moved out while the house is repaired, and nobody can explain where the engine came from.
Frank tells Donnie the world will end in twenty-eight days.
Donnie meets Gretchen Ross, a new girl seated next to him in English, and asks her out.
On Frank's instruction Donnie puts an axe through a water main to flood the school and buries the axe in the bronze mascot.
Donnie's therapist Dr. Thurman raises his medication and puts him under hypnosis.
Professor Monnitoff lends Donnie Roberta Sparrow's book The Philosophy of Time Travel.
Donnie starts seeing liquid spears of time coming out of people's chests and leading them where they are going.
Donnie humiliates the motivational speaker Jim Cunningham in front of the whole school, and the teacher Karen Pomeroy is sacked over her syllabus.
Cunningham is exposed as the owner of a child pornography ring after Donnie burns his house down.
Donnie and Gretchen sleep together during a Halloween party while his parents are away.
Donnie takes Gretchen to find Roberta Sparrow, and the bullies Seth and Ricky attack them at her house.
A car driven by Frank in his rabbit suit runs Gretchen down and kills her.
Donnie shoots Frank through the eye with his father's revolver.
Donnie carries Gretchen's body up the hill and watches a vortex open over his house.
Donnie sends the jet engine back through the vortex to the night of 2 October, closing the tangent universe, and on 30 October Gretchen cycles past the Darko house not knowing who died there.
syuzhet_notes: The film runs forward through twenty-eight captioned days, so most of its bullets sit in calendar order. The displacement that matters is the last one: told-order bullet 20 shows Donnie dying in his bed on 2 October, the first night of the story, withheld until after the film has shown the entire month that this death cancels. Told-order bullet 12 is a flashback to before the film's opening.
fabula_notes: The film's own logic makes a single clean chronology impossible - the jet engine that falls on 2 October is sent there from 30 October, so an event is its own cause. The ordering here is by calendar date, which puts Donnie's death fourth even though the film establishes it last; ordering instead by the tangent universe's internal experience would place it after everything else. Roberta Sparrow's remark predates the film and is reported rather than staged.
